Question 7
?

Find the y-intercepts of the circle (x−2)2+(y−4)2=9, shown above.

a
(0,6−3) and (0,6+3)
b
(0,4−3) and (0,4+3)
c
(0,4−5) and (0,4+5)
d
(0,5−3) and (0,5+3)
e
(0,5−5) and (0,5+5)
